summary.text: Andrew Myers is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 45A, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Tracey Breazeale. He is an attorney and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Myers was born in Rochester, Illinois.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Bradley University in 2001 and a J.D. from the University of Montana in 2004, and Ballotpedia says he has worked as owner and president of a law firm and in sales, consulting and business management.

In a 2021 Ballotpedia survey, Myers described himself as a husband, father of four, small business owner and attorney who has served as a City Council member, planning chair, police liaison and fire liaison and was then serving as parks chair for Tonka Bay.
Myers defeated Tracey Breazeale in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 45A, and Ballotpedia lists him as co-vice chair of the House Transportation Finance and Policy Committee.
